title: Discovery
description: The Discovery: the record sd-discover produces for one intent. The intent raises questions for people; each question carries where it could be answered, the search trail, the first-hand evidence found, the evidence against, and a status. What the rounds taught becomes learnings; the citations become stories, persona groups, and journey material, which the persona, journey, and blueprint writers build from. Rev 2026-09-29 (legion #1376): replaces the insight-and-verdict shape (weights, scores, the 0.40 bar) with question-driven discovery.

cited.description: A statement and the citation ids behind it. An empty text means the evidence leaves the item unsupported.

felt.description: Feelings in the words the evidence uses, each with its citations.

quoted.description: Verbatim quotes, each with the one citation it comes from.

date.description: The run date. Every answer is a finding as of this date.

intent.description: Id of the intent document this Discovery was raised from.

sources.description: Each source checked before round one, with the defects its sample showed. Each defect is a known limit on everything that source supplies.

defects.description: Each defect and how often it appeared.

id.description: Q<n> for a people question, D<n> for a design question.

kind.description: people: asks people about their own experience. design: asks whether the service should respond a particular way; answered through the people questions it spawns.

raised_by.description: What raised the question: an intent field path, a learning id, an action the person takes, or a design question id.

in_lens.description: True when the eavesdrop lens already crawls this place.

trail.description: How the evidence was found. A reader weighs an answer by what was searched and what stayed out of reach.

evidence.description: Citation ids that answer the question.

contradicting.description: Citation ids that point the other way, held to the same standard.

status.description: answered: three or more independent first-hand accounts from two or more source families, and no citation-worthy evidence against. contested: citation-worthy evidence points both ways. open: otherwise. A design question stays open; its people questions carry the answers.

few_voices.description: True when fewer than six independent voices stand behind the question.

expert_only.description: True when the answer rests only on accounts from people with a stake.

answer.description: What the evidence says as of the run date, citing each item. Present when answered or contested.

people_answers.description: Design questions: the people answers that bear on it, with their question ids.

ask.description: Open people questions: a direct-ask wording per place, phrased for that place's audience and norms.

spawned.description: Question ids raised from this one.

citations.description: Citation-worthy evidence: first-hand, locatable, stake declared, on the question, specific, current enough, genuine.

date_from.description: thread when only the thread's date is known.

family.description: The source family: one forum, one issue tracker, one subreddit, one blog.

thread.description: The thread URL, when the account is a reply.

text.description: Verbatim quote; following the URL finds the same words.

stake.description: The author's relationship to what they describe.

qualifies.description: Which evidence rules it meets and how, in one line.

from.description: Question or citation ids that taught it.

stories.description: One author's first-hand account read as a sequence, built from that author's citations only.

persona_groups.description: Stories that share a situation and a way of behaving. A group needs stories from three or more independent authors to stand as a persona.

relationship.description: The relationship to tools like this over time: first hearing, trying, adopting, relying, recommending or leaving, where the stories show it.

empty.description: Items no story supports, each with the question raised for it.

journeys.description: Journey material: per persona group, the stories aligned into stages in the order people went through them.

duration.description: How long the stage took, where a story says.

stories.description: Stories that reached the stage; one story means the stage is thin.

moments_of_truth.description: Moments where stories show people deciding to stay or leave.

crawl_list.description: Places found that the eavesdrop lens does not crawl yet.

notes.description: What the operator needs to decide.
